name: Potion of Clairvoyance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: The effect of the Clairvoyance spell (no Concentration).
text: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Clairvoyance spell (no Concentration needed). An eyeball bobs in the yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.
